MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, as supplied. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; 36% implies Internal Rotation. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), but sector returns are mixed and risk/cycle signals are unavailable, so directional conviction is limited.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads on the week: CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) and CMCSA (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +16.89%), both ABOVE TREND. Energy is rebounding, with COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) and EOG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: -1.61%) in RECOVERY; Consumer Staples is firm, with COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary is weakest by sector return (-3.24% 1W): ROST (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -5.87%) and F (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -5.79%) are BELOW TREND. Technology (-2.56%) and Materials (-2.64%) also lag; NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) and FCX (1W: -11.46% | 1M: -20.64%) are BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND; COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) RECOVERY; CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND; EOG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: -1.61%) RECOVERY; COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); the two Energy names are short-term rebounds, not established uptrends.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: RCL (1W: -5.69% | 1M: +14.46%) CORRECTION; ROST (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -5.87%) BELOW TREND; ETN (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -13.63%) BELOW TREND; F (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -5.79%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -38.26%) BELOW TREND. Weakness spans consumer, industrial and technology names, with INTC showing the deepest monthly decline.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W moves include CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) RECOVERY and CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND. Divergences are limited among the key stocks supplied; monitor COP and EOG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: -1.61%), both RECOVERY rather than confirmed trend turns.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with the sector down 2.56% for the week and 8.94% for the month; full-sector constituent breadth was not supplied. NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%), GOOGL (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -16.70%) and META (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -11.69%) are BELOW TREND, while AVGO (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +1.41%) and AAPL (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +2.79%) are ABOVE TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed: Financials fell 0.19% for the week but remain up 2.56% for the month. CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%), AIG (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +2.49%), V (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +6.12%) and MA (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +7.17%) are ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -0.44%) is BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Monthly gains remain intact, but the sector slipped 0.92% this week. LLY (1W: +1.52% | 1M: +14.03%), UNH (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +2.64%) and JNJ (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +10.56%) are ABOVE TREND; CVS (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -3.39%) is in RECOVERY and PFE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: -1.01%) is BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Stance?
Favor select Communication and Consumer Staples strength, while keeping exposure measured given NEUTRAL regime and 4/11 sector breadth. Style mixed / no clear leadership: Tech weakness contrasts with strength in select defensive and financial names, but breadth does not confirm a broad Growth or Value call.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND and CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND; monitor for follow-through. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) and INTC (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -38.26%), both BELOW TREND; stabilization would be needed to ease downside risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+2.06% 1W, +4.62% 1M) and Consumer Staples (+1.72% 1W, +5.57% 1M), among the four positive sectors. BEARISH: Technology (-2.56% 1W, -8.94% 1M) and Consumer Discretionary (-3.24% 1W, +4.51% 1M); overall breadth remains 4/11.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not provided. Watch whether NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) BELOW TREND stabilizes, whether CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND sustains momentum, and whether COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) RECOVERY progresses into a confirmed uptrend.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
Among names with supplied price data, COST (+45): price-target increase; COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment and price action confirming. Other high-scoring bullish catalysts in the news feed lack matching return data here, so price confirmation cannot be assessed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-50): Italy fine; META (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -11.69%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. NEM (-40): lower price target; NEM (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -6.99%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. CMCSA (-35): broadband competition concerns; CMCSA (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +16.89%) ABOVE TREND, a price/news divergence to monitor.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with breadth at 4/11 sectors positive; style is mixed, with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership. CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) and COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) are ABOVE TREND, while select Technology names remain weak. Monitor the divergence between negative CMCSA sentiment and its ABOVE TREND price action, alongside continued weakness in NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) BELOW TREND.
